## ARTICLE 26

In the document, Article 26 delves into the fundamental right to education. ## ARTICLE 29

In the document, Article 29 follows the preceding articles that outline fundamental human rights and freedoms. This section delves into the individual's responsibilities towards the community, emphasizing the importance of a society where personal development is unrestricted. It also underscores the limitations on the exercise of rights and freedoms, ensuring they align with the objectives and principles of the United Nations. The section concludes by stating that individuals are subject only to the restrictions set by law, primarily to safeguard the rights and freedoms of others.

## ARTICLE 30

In the document, Article 30 follows the preamble and is part of the main body, which outlines the rights and freedoms enshrined in the Universal Declaration of Human Rights. This section specifically addresses the interpretation of Article 30, which pertains to the prohibition of derogation from the rights and freedoms outlined in the Declaration. It emphasizes that no provision of the Declaration can be interpreted as allowing an individual, group, or state to derogate from these rights, even in times of public emergency. This section is crucial in understanding the absolute nature of human rights and their inviolability.
